<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 194.0862, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 193.0789 Da. A formula that matches this mass within experimental error is C₁₂H₁₄Cl (no oxygen). Following the required format CxHyOzX, the molecular formula is C12H14O0Cl.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H14O0Cl</final_answer>
